summary: One open window of the Studio: its actor, which library it works in, its profile, the focused view, the live dock arrangement and the input modifiers.

actor.doc: The window's actor ID, from the random source at start; every entry it writes carries it.

library.doc: Which library the window works in: the person's own, or the isolated verification copy.

focusView.doc: The last view to receive a pointer press or keyboard focus.

focusPanel.doc: The panel instance with keyboard focus, which decides what Undo acts on.

arrangement.doc: The live dock arrangement until it is saved into a layout.

migration.how: The library follows the URL at window start; the live arrangement is read from the workspace once, then kept per window.

x-friction.gap: The verification scope is a whole separate library, settings and workspace chosen by URL: neither a profile nor a fork but a second graph.
x-friction.closes: Several graphs side by side on one host, chosen per window.

x-friction.gap: Two windows on one library must see each other's commits live; today the second tab overwrites the first's workspace.
x-friction.closes: Commits pushed from the host to every window on the same library.
